visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged Asian man with short hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands centrally against a textured gray wall environment. To his right, an orange traffic cone stands on the ground. He speaks with expressive hand gestures while holding a small black electronic presenter remote. (2) The scene cuts to a static digital display of a research paper from Science Advances. The text is crisp and technical. (3) Transition back to the man in the studio setting; he continues his explanation using wide arm movements and varied facial expressions, including squinting and smiling for emphasis. (4) A graphical diagram appears, illustrating the differences between mouse and human embryo implantation models on 3D and 2D platforms with various labels. (5) Side-by-side scientific visualization: the left side shows a microscope video of a reddish mouse embryo, while the right side displays a colorful heat map with arrows indicating outward force vectors. (6) A second side-by-side visualization shows a human embryo in greenish-yellow microscope footage on the left, and a corresponding heat map on the right showing concentrated inward force vectors. (7) High-resolution grayscale microscope footage shows a micro-needle periodically pressing against the edge of a spherical embryo, with a scale bar labeled 100 micrometers. (8) The man returns to the eye-level studio shot to conclude his presentation, using high-energy gestures and holding the remote.
